Part 1 - Classes and Methods / ODTransform

SetQDOffset

Mac OS

The SetQDOffset method changes this transform into a pure offset with the specified integral horizontal and vertical translation values.

ODTransform SetQDOffset (in Point point);
point
A QuickDraw point that represents the new offset for this transform.
return value
A reference to this transform changed to an offset transform with integral translation values.
DISCUSSION
The specified translation values are integer values.

SEE ALSO
The ODTransform::GetQDOffset method (page 770).
